small.title: Use the side button to turn on iPhone. You can use the side button (along with either volume button on some models) or S
small.header_path: Turn iPhone on or off
small.page_content:
Use the side button to turn on iPhone. You can use the side button (along with either volume button on some models) or Settings ![](https://help.apple.com/assets/683A54F5227CBBDB98051B96/683A54FC545676DF600F97D4/en_US/88b2400e45bcf521514b7252cbb2d959.png) to turn off iPhone.
If your iPhone isn’t working as expected, you can try restarting it by turning it off, then turning it back on. If turning it off and on doesn’t fix the issue, try [forcing it to restart](https://support.apple.com/en-in/guide/iphone/force-restart-iphone-iph8903c3ee6/18.0/ios/18.0).

small.title: With the push of a button or flip of a switch, you can quickly silence your iPhone.
small.header_path: Silence iPhone
small.page_content: With the push of a button or flip of a switch, you can quickly silence your iPhone.

small.title: * _iPhone with Face ID:_ Simultaneously press and hold the side button and either volume button until the sliders appear
small.header_path: Turn iPhone on or off > Turn off iPhone
small.page_content:
* _iPhone with Face ID:_ Simultaneously press and hold the side button and either volume button until the sliders appear, then drag the Power Off slider.
* _iPhone with the Home button:_ Press and hold the side button, then drag the slider.
![Illustrations of two different iPhone models with the screens facing up. The leftmost illustration shows the volume up and volume down buttons on the left side of the device and the side button on the right. The rightmost illustration shows the side button on the right of the device.](https://help.apple.com/assets/683A54F5227CBBDB98051B96/683A54FC545676DF600F97D4/en_US/922045a91e7a8c81b136a0061aecf43c.png)
* _All models:_ Go to Settings ![](https://help.apple.com/assets/683A54F5227CBBDB98051B96/683A54FC545676DF600F97D4/en_US/88b2400e45bcf521514b7252cbb2d959.png) > General > Shut Down, then drag the slider.  
**See also**[Force restart iPhone](https://support.apple.com/en-in/guide/iphone/force-restart-iphone-iph8903c3ee6/18.0/ios/18.0)

small.title: * On [supported models](https://support.apple.com/en-in/guide/iphone/aside/iph44c8b4227/26/ios/26): [Open Control Center
small.header_path: Select ringtones on iPhone > Turn the ringer on or off
small.page_content:
* On [supported models](https://support.apple.com/en-in/guide/iphone/aside/iph44c8b4227/26/ios/26): [Open Control Center](https://support.apple.com/en-in/guide/iphone/aside/iph7c412b4db/26/ios/26), then tap ![the Mute Switch button](https://help.apple.com/assets/69829802B4459E3FD3081043/698298085EBD953E6D0E983B/en_US/b2b2f4cd52ef62e379f7b56d582279dc.png).
You can also configure the Action Button to turn the ringer on or off. See [Customize the Action button](https://support.apple.com/en-in/guide/iphone/use-and-customize-the-action-button-iphe89d61d66/26/ios/26#iph7f3b44a7e).
* On other models: Flip the Ring/Silent switch to turn Silent mode on or off.  
Clock alarms still play when Silent mode is turned on.
To temporarily silence incoming calls, [turn on or schedule a Focus on iPhone](https://support.apple.com/en-in/guide/iphone/turn-a-focus-on-or-off-iph5c3f5b77b/26/ios/26).
You can also change the default sound that plays when you receive a call, text, voicemail, email, reminder, or other notification. To learn more, see [Customize your iPhone sounds and vibrations](https://support.apple.com/en-in/guide/iphone/change-sounds-and-vibrations-iph07c867f28/26/ios/26#iph5c79226c7).

small.title: 1. To see all your open apps, do one of the following:
small.header_path: Switch between open apps on iPhone > Use the App Switcher
small.page_content:
1. To see all your open apps, do one of the following:
* _On an iPhone with Face ID:_ Swipe up from the bottom of the screen, pause in the center of the screen, then lift your finger.
* _On an iPhone with a Home button:_ Double-click the Home button.
2. To browse the open apps, swipe right, then tap the app you want to use.
![The App Switcher. Icons for the open apps appear at the top, and the current screen for each open app appears below its icon.](https://help.apple.com/assets/683A54F5227CBBDB98051B96/683A54FC545676DF600F97D4/en_US/df11b19f215459e53d4dfbe6bb048e4a.png)

small.title: You can quickly switch from one open app to another on your iPhone. When you switch back, you can pick up right where yo
small.header_path: Switch between open apps on iPhone
small.page_content: You can quickly switch from one open app to another on your iPhone. When you switch back, you can pick up right where you left off.

small.title: You can quickly open apps from one of your Home Screen pages (like the one shown below) or your [App Library](https://su
small.header_path: Open apps on iPhone
small.page_content:
You can quickly open apps from one of your Home Screen pages (like the one shown below) or your [App Library](https://support.apple.com/en-in/guide/iphone/find-and-use-your-apps-in-app-library-iph87abad19a/18.0/ios/18.0).
![A screenshot showing an example of the default Home Screen that comes with iOS 18.](https://help.apple.com/assets/683A54F5227CBBDB98051B96/683A54FC545676DF600F97D4/en_US/e5486dcf4a91009eb02814bd2abc9c42.png)
1. To go to the Home Screen, swipe up from the bottom edge of the screen (on an iPhone with Face ID) or press the Home button (on an iPhone with a Home button).
2. Swipe left to browse apps on other Home Screen pages.
3. Swipe left past all your Home Screen pages to see App Library, where your apps are organized by category.
4. To open an app, tap its icon.
5. To return to App Library, swipe up from the bottom edge of the screen (on an iPhone with Face ID) or press the Home button (on an iPhone with a Home button).

large.title: * On [supported models](https://support.apple.com/en-in/guide/iphone/aside/iph44c8b4227/26/ios/26): [Open Control Center
large.header_path: Select ringtones on iPhone > Turn the ringer on or off
large.page_content:
* On [supported models](https://support.apple.com/en-in/guide/iphone/aside/iph44c8b4227/26/ios/26): [Open Control Center](https://support.apple.com/en-in/guide/iphone/aside/iph7c412b4db/26/ios/26), then tap ![the Mute Switch button](https://help.apple.com/assets/69829802B4459E3FD3081043/698298085EBD953E6D0E983B/en_US/b2b2f4cd52ef62e379f7b56d582279dc.png).
You can also configure the Action Button to turn the ringer on or off. See [Customize the Action button](https://support.apple.com/en-in/guide/iphone/use-and-customize-the-action-button-iphe89d61d66/26/ios/26#iph7f3b44a7e).
* On other models: Flip the Ring/Silent switch to turn Silent mode on or off.  
Clock alarms still play when Silent mode is turned on.
To temporarily silence incoming calls, [turn on or schedule a Focus on iPhone](https://support.apple.com/en-in/guide/iphone/turn-a-focus-on-or-off-iph5c3f5b77b/26/ios/26).
You can also change the default sound that plays when you receive a call, text, voicemail, email, reminder, or other notification. To learn more, see [Customize your iPhone sounds and vibrations](https://support.apple.com/en-in/guide/iphone/change-sounds-and-vibrations-iph07c867f28/26/ios/26#iph5c79226c7).

small.title: On iPhone, you can change the wallpaper on the Lock Screen and the Home Screen. You can set your wallpaper in Settings o
small.header_path: Change the wallpaper on iPhone
small.page_content:
On iPhone, you can change the wallpaper on the Lock Screen and the Home Screen. You can set your wallpaper in Settings or through the wallpaper gallery from your Lock Screen. See [Create a custom iPhone Lock Screen](https://support.apple.com/en-in/guide/iphone/create-a-custom-lock-screen-iph4d0e6c351/26/ios/26).
![The Wallpaper Settings screen, with buttons for customizing the current wallpaper on the Home Screen and Lock Screen, and the Add New Wallpaper button for changing the wallpaper.](https://help.apple.com/assets/69829802B4459E3FD3081043/698298085EBD953E6D0E983B/en_US/6f16d306fed90be94d213cdd1687e7b9.png)
1. Go to the Settings app ![](https://help.apple.com/assets/69829802B4459E3FD3081043/698298085EBD953E6D0E983B/en_US/610900798ec772fa266e98f9f6042807.png) on your iPhone.
2. Tap Wallpaper, then tap Add New Wallpaper.
3. Tap one of the wallpaper options, then make additional changes to the Lock Screen.
4. Tap Add, then do one of the following:
* _Choose to use the wallpaper on both the Lock Screen and Home Screen:_ Tap Set as Wallpaper Pair.
* _Make changes to the Home Screen:_ Tap Customize Home Screen. Tap a color to change the wallpaper color, tap ![the Photo On Rectangle button](https://help.apple.com/assets/69829802B4459E3FD3081043/698298085EBD953E6D0E983B/en_US/b5bfd24869a69ca545847f0b0a3efe9a.png) to use a custom photo, or select Blur to blur the wallpaper so the apps stand out.
